issues.text: .badge-notification's background was converted to dark-light-choose but the paired foreground color stays hardcoded to $secondary, so in dark theme both colors derive from $secondary and end up close together, dropping contrast well below WCAG AA on some usage sites.
issues.zh: .badge-notification 的背景改成由 $secondary 起算，但前景仍固定 $secondary，dark theme 的對比反而變差。

issues.text: The light-theme color for .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a was also changed (30% to 70%) during what was supposed to be a dark-theme-only conversion; the two lightness arguments appear to be swapped.
issues.zh: .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a 的 light theme 顏色被一起改掉（30% → 70%），兩個引數疑似寫反。

issues.text: Mobile's .custom-message-length light-theme color was changed and now runs in the opposite direction from the equivalent desktop rule, which used to share the same value before this change.
issues.zh: mobile .custom-message-length 的 light theme 顏色被改掉，且與 desktop 同名規則方向相反。

issues.text: Mobile's .topic-map h3 light-theme color was changed and now matches the adjacent h4's color exactly, erasing the visual hierarchy between title and subtitle, and diverging from the desktop equivalent which kept the original value.
issues.zh: mobile .topic-map h3 的 light theme 顏色被改掉，與同區塊的 h4 變成同色，且與 desktop 對應規則不再一致。

issues.text: .group-member-info .name's light-theme color was changed in both desktop and mobile files, making it identical to the adjacent .title color and erasing the visual hierarchy between name and title.
issues.zh: .group-member-info .name 的 light theme 顏色被改掉，與同層的 .title 變成同色。

issues.text: One .badge-notification declaration (.topic-list.categories .category) was missed by the conversion sweep and remains as the old unconverted scale-color($primary) call.

The same light/dark color-mapping rule is manually duplicated 116 times across 32 files with no single place to maintain the invariant that the two lightness arguments sum to 100, which is the direct cause of several of the drift bugs found in this review.
issues.zh: 同一條 light/dark 對映規則被逐字展開 116 次，建議抽成一個 function。

issues.text: A code comment referencing a default scale-color value is now stale/inaccurate since the referenced rule was converted to dark-light-choose by this change.
issues.zh: 註解裡引用的預設值在這次改動後已經失準。

issues.text: The conversion incidentally reformatted trailing whitespace (';}' to '; }') in five places but left an identically-formed line elsewhere unchanged, mixing unrelated whitespace changes into the diff.
issues.zh: 轉換時順手改了行尾空白，同一批改動裡沒有統一。

open_questions.text: In the mobile editor's disabled state under dark theme, will the newly-changed background color and the unchanged, non-theme-aware text color end up clashing?
open_questions.zh: mobile 編輯器 disabled 狀態下，dark theme 的背景與文字色會不會撞在一起？

open_questions.text: Is it intentional that the equivalent sweep for scale-color($secondary, ...) and scale-color($tertiary, ...) declarations was left out of scope for this commit?
open_questions.zh: 反方向的同類寫法（只在 dark theme 成立的 scale-color($secondary, ...)）是刻意留到之後處理，還是漏掉了？
